related.title: Krafla 地熱與回注系統
related.transfer: 可遷移「套管的自由熱伸長」與「溫度測井與冷水入侵」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；Krafla 地熱與回注系統的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Free thermal growth of casing" and "Temperature logs and cold-water entry" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Krafla geothermal and reinjection system must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦看不見的井身出了什麼事：熱伸長、環空升壓、剩餘壁厚、溫度測井與熱循環；Krafla 地熱與回注系統則以蓋在活火山上的電廠：岩漿上方的熱通量、火山氣體、套管熱應力與延後二十年的機組為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on what is happening to a well nobody can see: thermal growth, annular pressure, remaining wall, temperature logs and thermal cycles; Krafla geothermal and reinjection system centres on A plant on an active volcano: heat flux above magma, volcanic gas, casing thermal stress and a unit twenty years late, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「地溫梯度與鑽井深度」與「熱源溫度與效率上限」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「二氧化矽過飽和與結垢」的模型移到Krafla 地熱與回注系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「不凝結氣體的抽氣功率」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Geothermal gradient and drilling depth" and "Source temperature and the efficiency ceiling".
Move the model of "Silica supersaturation and scaling" to Krafla geothermal and reinjection system, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Power to extract non-condensable gas", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「套管的自由熱伸長」與「溫度測井與冷水入侵」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；Krafla 地熱與回注系統的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Free thermal growth of casing" and "Temperature logs and cold-water entry" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Krafla geothermal and reinjection system must be respecified.

related.title: 增強型地熱儲層監測概念
related.transfer: 可遷移「套管的自由熱伸長」與「溫度測井與冷水入侵」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；增強型地熱儲層監測概念的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Free thermal growth of casing" and "Temperature logs and cold-water entry" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Enhanced Geothermal Reservoir Monitoring Concepts must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦看不見的井身出了什麼事：熱伸長、環空升壓、剩餘壁厚、溫度測井與熱循環；增強型地熱儲層監測概念則以監看一個人造的地下熱儲：注入體積與地震規模、示蹤試驗、熱壽命、b 值與裂隙開啟壓力為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on what is happening to a well nobody can see: thermal growth, annular pressure, remaining wall, temperature logs and thermal cycles; Enhanced Geothermal Reservoir Monitoring Concepts centres on watching an engineered reservoir underground: injected volume and magnitude, tracer tests, thermal life, b-value and fracture opening pressure, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「地溫梯度與鑽井深度」與「地溫梯度與鑽井深度」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「二氧化矽過飽和與結垢」的模型移到增強型地熱儲層監測概念，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「示蹤劑與掃掠體積」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Geothermal gradient and drilling depth" and "Geothermal gradient and drilling depth".
Move the model of "Silica supersaturation and scaling" to Enhanced Geothermal Reservoir Monitoring Concepts, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Tracers and swept volume", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「套管的自由熱伸長」與「溫度測井與冷水入侵」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；增強型地熱儲層監測概念的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Free thermal growth of casing" and "Temperature logs and cold-water entry" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Enhanced Geothermal Reservoir Monitoring Concepts must be respecified.
